scientific.integrity: The all-parameter theorem is proved analytically from the delta matching conditions, ground-state positivity and simplicity, reflection symmetry, and strict convexity. Numerical transfer-matrix checks are corroborative only.
scientific.limitations: The theorem treats exactly two equal repulsive delta interactions on a one-dimensional periodic loop. It does not prove the conjecture for N>=3, unequal strengths, magnetic flux, or other matching conditions.

title: All-coupling antipodal optimality for two repulsive point interactions on a loop
